description: Fix the Salas 'infinite recursion detected in policy for relation room_members [42P17]' error with a NEW re-runnable migration supabase/migrations/0020_fix_room_members_rls_recursion.sql, and update docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md. Root cause (verified in 0011_rls_policies.sql): rooms_select contains an inline EXISTS over room_members, and room_members_select contains an inline EXISTS over rooms; each policy's subquery triggers the OTHER table's RLS, which re-triggers the first - a mutual recursion Postgres rejects with 42P17. Standard fix: break the cycle with SECURITY DEFINER helper function(s) that read the fact WITHOUT triggering RLS, mirroring the existing public.is_admin() pattern, then rewrite the two policies to call the helpers instead of inline cross-table EXISTS. This feature is INDEPENDENT of the frontend features (FEAT-002, FEAT-003) and is backend-only. NOTE: there is NO live Supabase in the sandbox, so the SQL cannot be executed or verified here - it is validated by careful logic/structural review only and MUST be applied + verified by a human against a real database.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/0020_fix_room_members_rls_recursion.sql. Do NOT edit 0011 or any existing migration.

In 0020, define SECURITY DEFINER helper functions mirroring public.is_admin() in 0010_domain_functions.sql EXACTLY in style: use 'create or replace function', 'language sql', 'stable', 'security definer', 'set search_path = public', and a trailing 'grant execute ... to authenticated'. Define: public.is_room_member(p_room_id uuid, p_user_id uuid) returns boolean (select exists (select 1 from public.room_members rm where rm.room_id = p_room_id and rm.user_id = p_user_id and rm.status = 'active')); and public.is_room_educator(p_room_id uuid, p_user_id uuid default auth.uid()) returns boolean (select exists (select 1 from public.rooms r where r.id = p_room_id and r.educator_id = p_user_id)). Because these are SECURITY DEFINER they bypass RLS, so the cross-table reads no longer re-enter the recursive policies.

In 0020, drop-if-exists then re-create the two recursive policies from 0011 to use the helpers: rooms_select -> using (educator_id = auth.uid() or public.is_admin() or public.is_room_member(rooms.id, auth.uid())); room_members_select -> using (user_id = auth.uid() or public.is_admin() or public.is_room_educator(room_members.room_id, auth.uid())). Use 'drop policy if exists <name> on public.<table>;' before each 'create policy' so the migration is re-runnable.

Re-check announcements_select and missions_select from 0011: they reference room_members from a DIFFERENT table (announcements/missions), so a single-direction EXISTS over room_members does NOT create a cycle with rooms. Confirm in the migration header comment they are NOT part of the recursion and are left unchanged (they do not reference rooms AND room_members mutually). If, on review, their inline room_members EXISTS could still trip RLS re-entrancy through room_members_select's new helper, prefer rewriting their room_members EXISTS to use public.is_room_member for consistency and safety; document the decision in a comment.

Grant execute on the new helper functions to the authenticated role (grant execute on function public.is_room_member(uuid, uuid) to authenticated; grant execute on function public.is_room_educator(uuid, uuid) to authenticated;), consistent with how domain functions are exposed.
Add a top-of-file comment block in 0020 explaining the 42P17 root cause, the fix, and that it must be applied against a real DB (mirroring the explanatory comment style of 0011/0019).

Update docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md: add a '0020_fix_room_members_rls_recursion.sql' row to the ordered migration table in section 2 (fix the stated range from 0001-0019 to 0001-0020); add a subsection under section 3 explaining what 0020 does and why (the 42P17 recursion fix) and that it must be applied in order; update the section 5 human checklist to reference 0001 -> 0020; explicitly state that 0020 only changes POLICIES + FUNCTIONS and therefore does NOT change the generated Database type, so a src/types/database.ts regen is NOT required for 0020.

Also update README.md where it references the migration range if trivial (the Setup section says '0001_ -> 0016_' and a note mentions 0017-0019); update to include 0020. Keep edits minimal and factual.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/0020_fix_room_members_rls_recursion.sql exists and no existing migration file was modified or deleted.

The migration defines public.is_room_member and public.is_room_educator as SECURITY DEFINER STABLE functions with 'set search_path = public' and grants execute to authenticated, matching the is_admin() style in 0010.
rooms_select and room_members_select are dropped-if-exists then re-created to call the helper functions instead of inline cross-table EXISTS, eliminating the mutual recursion.
The migration is re-runnable (create or replace function; drop policy if exists then create policy) and parses as valid-looking PostgreSQL under structural review.
docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md lists 0020 in the ordered table, explains it, updates the checklist range, and states a type regen is not needed for 0020.
A clear statement is included (in the migration header and reported back) that the SQL could not be executed in the sandbox and must be applied + verified against a real Supabase database.
verification: Structural/logical review of 0020 (SQL cannot be executed here - no live Supabase): confirm function signatures, SECURITY DEFINER + search_path, policy drop/create re-runnability, and that the recursion is broken.
Run 'npm run build', 'npm run typecheck', 'npm run lint', 'npm run test' to confirm the SQL/doc changes did not break the frontend (they should be no-ops for TS).
grep the migration to confirm both policies no longer contain an inline cross-table EXISTS between rooms and room_members.
findings: Created supabase/migrations/0020_fix_room_members_rls_recursion.sql (new file only; no existing migration edited or deleted). Defined two SECURITY DEFINER STABLE helpers mirroring public.is_admin() exactly (create or replace function; language sql; stable; security definer; set search_path = public): public.is_room_member(p_room_id uuid, p_user_id uuid) and public.is_room_educator(p_room_id uuid, p_user_id uuid default auth.uid()), each with a grant execute ... to authenticated. Rewrote rooms_select and room_members_select (drop policy if exists then create policy, so re-runnable) to call the helpers instead of inline cross-table EXISTS, breaking the mutual rooms<->room_members recursion that caused 42P17. Verified via grep that neither policy still contains an inline cross-table EXISTS between rooms and room_members. IMPORTANT CONTEXT discovered: 0015_rankings.sql had already re-created room_members_select and added a SECURITY DEFINER helper public.is_active_room_member(uuid); 0020's room_members_select preserves that 'active member sees roster' branch (keeps calling is_active_room_member) while routing the educator check through the new is_room_educator helper, and rooms_select now uses is_room_member - this is behavior-preserving. Defensive-consistency decision (documented inline in the migration): announcements_select and missions_select are NOT part of the rooms<->room_members cycle (they live on announcements/missions, single-direction read into room_members), but their inline room_members EXISTS was rewritten to use public.is_room_member() for uniform, recursion-safe membership reads; their educator-path inline rooms EXISTS was left unchanged (no cycle). Updated docs/DATABASE_SETUP.md: added the 0020 row to the section 2 table, changed the range 0001-0019 to 0001-0020 (table intro, note, SQL-editor fallback), added a section 3 subsection explaining the 42P17 root cause + fix, and the section 5 checklist (range to 0020 + a Salas manual-verification step). Stated explicitly in both the migration header and DATABASE_SETUP.md that 0020 changes only POLICIES + FUNCTIONS (no column/table/enum/view), so the generated Database type is unchanged and a src/types/database.ts regen is NOT required for 0020. Minimal README.md updates: migration range 0001_->0020_ and the recent-migrations note 0017-0020. UNVERIFIABLE: the SQL could NOT be executed in the sandbox (no live Supabase); it was validated by structural/logical review only and MUST be applied and verified by a human against a real database (apply in filename order after 0019, then open the Salas page and confirm the list loads without the 42P17 error, as educator and as active member). Frontend verification (TS no-ops as expected): npm run build PASS, npm run typecheck PASS, npm run lint = 6 pre-existing warnings only (0 errors, no new warnings), npm run test = 161 passed / 11 files.
